en: Replace existing account definitions: {replaced} with this conversation's copy. This also copies {created}. Add `yes` to replace and copy — nothing has changed yet.

context.role: rehearsal line when one plan both overwrites and copies
context.note: {replaced} names the account definitions that would be overwritten; {created} names the new copies. The overwrite comes first in the sentence and the notice is `warning` for the same reason as promote_replace_plan. `yes` stays literal.

en: Add `yes` to copy {names} into your account — nothing has changed yet.
ur: {names} کو اپنے اکاؤنٹ میں کاپی کرنے کے لیے `yes` شامل کریں — ابھی کچھ نہیں بدلا۔

context.role: rehearsal line before a confirmed copy
context.tone: plain, calm, explicit that nothing changed
context.note: {names} is a comma-joined list of the definitions a confirmed call would copy into the account. `yes` stays a literal token. Never reads as a warning: copying is a normal, reversible-in-effect act.

ur: {names} کو آپ کے اکاؤنٹ میں کاپی کیا گیا۔

context.note: {names} is the comma-joined list of definitions newly COPIED into the account. Never includes a replaced row: a replacement needs its own sentence (design round 1, D2).

en: This conversation keeps its own copy.
ur: یہ گفتگو اپنی کاپی ہی استعمال کرتی رہے گی۔

context.note: The clause users get wrong (the origin conversation keeps launching its own row), split out so it survives whatever precedes it. Never dropped.

ur: آپ کے اکاؤنٹ میں بدل دیے گئے: {names}۔

context.note: {names} is the comma-joined list of EXISTING account definitions this call overwrote. Printed only when something was replaced, so a copy-only receipt never implies a loss (design round 1, D2 / UX U1).

en: Replace existing account definitions: {names} with this conversation's copy. Add `yes` to replace — nothing has changed yet.
ur: اکاؤنٹ کی موجودہ تعریفات کو اس گفتگو کی کاپی سے بدلیں: {names}۔ تبدیلی کے لیے `yes` شامل کریں — ابھی کچھ نہیں بدلا۔

context.role: rehearsal line before a confirmed overwrite
context.tone: plain, direct, names what will be lost; leads the notice
context.note: {names} is a comma-joined list of the account definitions the confirmed call would OVERWRITE. This sentence is printed FIRST and as a `warning` notice (design round 1, D1): the destructive half must never read as an afterthought to the copies. `yes` stays literal.
